data.long_meaning: In Arabic, the name Kasir refers to a potter or an artisan. This name has a spiritual significance in Islam as it implies the creation and shaping of beautiful things, reflecting the divine power of Allah in creating the universe. The name Kasir carries the meaning “Potter, artisan” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kasir usually hope their child will grow to embody potter, artisan and live with faith, good character and purpose.
